name: console-chat-native-dialog-frame
goal: Capture the full native console picker with its chat

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Open model and effort pickers are native dialogs that extend beyond the fixed chat panel on desktop and tablet.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The previous check searched only for explicit dialog roles and timed out; the standardized assertion must locate native dialogs and check their capture bounds.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
